descriptor: Neon arcade snake with a modern feel

voice.summary: Pixel Serpent talks like an arcade cabinet: short, bright and direct. It encourages quick restarts and treats every death as a prompt for one more go.
dos: Use two-word prompts such as 'Press start'
Suggest replay immediately after game over

boilerplate: Pixel Serpent is a neon arcade snake game with smooth controls, speed levels, power-up pellets and best-score tracking for quick sessions on any device.

microcopy.error: Game over. Press restart to try again.
microcopy.empty: Press an arrow key or swipe to start.

logo.note: A wavy line suggests the snake's body and a neon arcade glow.
